# DevExpress.Win NuGet Package

This is the master runtime-only package for [DevExpress WinForms controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/), a comprehensive suite of Microsoft Office-inspired UI components. The DevExpress WinForms subscription includes the WinForms Data Grid, Pivot Grid, Excel-inspired Spreadsheet, and Word-inspired Rich Text Editor.

The DevExpress.Win package does not include IDE integration capabilities. For design-time development, use [DevExpress.Win.Design](https://www.nuget.org/packages/DevExpress.Win.Design/).

## Key Features

* More than 190 controls and UI libraries for Windows Forms

* AI-powered development support

* High-performance data shaping for large data sources

* DevExpress Reports, a comprehensive reporting suite

* DirectX hardware acceleration for faster rendering on high-DPI displays

* Built-in HTML- and CSS-based formatting support

* Accessibility-focused design

## Evaluation Period, Pricing Options, and Licensing Terms

Whether you own a license or want to start a 30-day evaluation, download and register your DevExpress license key. To obtain the key, sign in to the [DevExpress Download Manager](https://www.devexpress.com/ClientCenter/DownloadManager/) with your existing DevExpress.com account or create a free account. For instructions on key registration, see [License Key for DevExpress Products](https://www.devexpress.com/go/Licensing_Documentation.aspx).

If you purchase a license after evaluating a product, you need to re-register your updated DevExpress license key to remove evaluation warnings and messages. 

This package is included in the following commercial subscriptions:

* [DevExpress WinForms Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/)

* [DevExpress DXperience Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/dxperience.xml)

* [DevExpress Universal Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/universal.xml)

* [DevExpress .NET Reporting Subscription](https://www.devexpress.com/subscriptions/reporting/)

See [DevExpress Subscriptions & Licensing](https://www.devexpress.com/buy) for subscription comparison tables, purchasing FAQ, and licensing information.
